period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported) vs 31-Dec-2023. Income-statement items recorded here are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2024 (9-month YTD); the source also independently discloses discrete 3-month (Jul-Sep 2024) figures, not stored as separate line items. SOLO/STANDALONE basis. Source PDF is a scanned filing (cover page unreadable noise, data pages good OCR quality). The 31-Dec-2023 comparative here for Total Assets (10,685,391,288), Total Liabilities (23,555,314,377), equity (-12,869,923,089), deposits (12,316,117,976) and investments (7,909,731,309) all match 2023_Q4.json exactly, and this filing's own Dec-2023 comparative REVERTS to these correct figures after the isolated ~52m Dec-2023 anomaly found in the immediately preceding 2024_Q2.json filing (see that file's period_note) -- confirming the Q2 filing's discrepancy was a one-off data-entry slip in that single filing rather than a genuine progressive restatement. SEPARATE MINOR DISCREPANCY: this filing's own Dec-2023 comparative for 'Total Off-Balance Sheet items' (247,557,193) does not match 2023_Q4.json's contingent_liabilities (223,444,841) for the same date; 223,444,841 is corroborated independently by 2024_Q1.json's own (correct) Dec-2023 comparative, so 247,557,193 here appears to be a stale carryover of the bank's own Sep-2023 off-balance-sheet total (matching 2023_Q3.json) mistakenly left in this filing's comparative column -- this quarter's own reported 30-Sep-2024 figure (223,908,621) is unaffected either way. Income-statement chain closes exactly (A-B=C, C-D=PBT with D correctly printed with parentheses this time, PBT-tax=PAT, PAT/664,702,300 shares=EPS -0.71, matching the filing's own Notes section); the 9M-2023 comparative column matches 2023_Q3.json's own figures exactly on every field.
